data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a small net release of prior year reserves of $9.3m in 2022 (approximately -0.85% of opening gross claims outstanding of $1,096.5m). The release was driven by favourable prior-year development primarily in MAP Risks and Property Risks and was partly offset by a strengthening in the Cyber Risks division (notably on the 2020 underwriting year). The report notes prior years were affected by pandemic and natural catastrophe activity (e.g. Hurricane Laura, Ida, Storm Uri), but 2022 reserve movements were modest and within expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding) at 31-Dec-2021 = 1,096.5 (USD millions). The reported prior year movement used is the managing agent's narrative figure 'released prior year reserves of $9.3m' (page 4) and the divisional table (Cyber, Digital, MAP, Property, Specialty) - the report labels the table 'Net (releases)/strengthening', which suggests these division numbers may be net of reinsurance; a gross (insurance liabilities) explicit prior-year movement note was not found. Therefore the prior year movement used may be net of reinsurance rather than gross; no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line was located. All amounts are in the report's functional currency (USD). Claims development triangle (loss-ratio style) is present and was captured; the triangle includes a '2012 ae' aggregate column which has been excluded per instructions. Prior year development figure may be understated/overstated relative to a gross-only measure because only a net narrative figure was available.
